props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Configure vLLM to mitigate: Data contamination

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Risk description: Data contamination occurs when incorrect data is used for training. For example, data that is not aligned with model's purpose or data that is already set aside for other development tasks such as testing and evaluation. Concern: Data that differs from the intended training data might skew model accuracy and affect model outcomes. Configure vLLM inference and serving deployments (engine version, model selection, quantization, batching policy, OpenAI-compatible API, and logging) so that this risk is mitigated across online and batch inference. Use robust model selection from HuggingFace, safe default decoding parameters, resource limits (max tokens, concurrency), and integration with upstream/downstream safety components to ensure that model behavior under vLLM matches documented expectations for this risk.

Track metrics per vLLM deployment, model, and configuration (e.g., quantization, max tokens, parallelism settings).
